cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My ribbon or Nina's for the club election? I taught you chess; you used to be able to choose a side.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you haven't knocked either piece off the board. Now which friend do you want as chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wear yours today and hers tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow's the vote. You've remembered two moves but missed the important one. Choose tomorrow's ribbon first; I'll lend you whichever one you're only practising with today.

reason: Use the claimed pupil relationship to shape the precise authority pursuit, keeping each partner response an actual cause of the next tactic.
